mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness that triggers Fed rate-cut expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 0.5% in the past month signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and RSAFS declines > 0.5% in past month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (2017=100) in a late-cycle slowdown regime signals manufacturing weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and regime is late-cycle slowdown, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 1.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth above 100k per month signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing market activity (HOUST below 700,000 units) in a weak housing market regime triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 700.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in federal funds rate and CPI exceeding 0.25% and 0.5% respectively signal unaccommodated monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in past month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise by specified thresholds, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
